/magic-item:adventurer-s-ring: Open the cover to shed bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20 feet; the flame produces no heat or fuel consumption. Open or close it as a Bonus Action.
/magic-item:bead-of-refreshment: Dissolves in liquid and converts up to one pint into cold fresh water. It cannot affect magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison.
/magic-item:cast-off-armor: This light, medium, or heavy armor can be removed with a Magic action.
/magic-item:cloak-of-many-fashions: As a Bonus Action, alter the cloak’s style, color, and apparent quality. Its weight stays constant and it remains a cloak; its appearance cannot give it magical properties.
/magic-item:conjurer-s-canopy: A Magic action and command word plants the stick and creates a 20-foot cube of transparent force for 1 hour, sheltering its contents from ordinary weather while allowing passage. End it early with a Magic action; after it ends, reuse requires 1d12 hours.
/magic-item:dread-helm: While worn, this helmet casts the wearer’s face in shadow and makes their eyes glow red.
/magic-item:enduring-spellbook: The book and its writing resist fire and water damage and do not deteriorate with age.
/magic-item:eternal-chalk: The chalk does not break or wear out through ordinary use. Choose each mark’s color and whether it glows faintly; only you can erase your marks for 7 days.
/magic-item:hat-of-wizardry: Use as a Wizard spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, a Magic action attempts an unknown Wizard cantrip with an action casting time: DC 10 Arcana check; failure wastes the action.
/magic-item:horn-of-silent-alarm: Four charges; regain 1d4 daily at dawn. A Magic action and one charge lets a selected creature within 600 feet hear the horn; others hear nothing.
/magic-item:lock-of-trickery: This lock has a key and shifts its tumblers magically, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks to pick it.
/magic-item:mask-of-changed-appearance: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend one with a Magic action for minor facial alterations for 1 hour; it cannot impersonate another person, and the mask becomes Invisible during the effect. Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:mystery-key: Each lock into which the key fits has a 5% chance of opening. The key disappears after successfully opening a lock.
/magic-item:orb-of-time: Use as an Arcane Focus. On the Material Plane, a Magic action while holding it reveals whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or night.
/magic-item:pole-of-angling: A Magic action while holding the pole changes it into a fishing pole with hook, line, and reel, or changes it back.
/magic-item:potion-of-comprehension: Drinking grants the effects of Comprehend Languages for 1 hour.
/magic-item:prosthetic-limb: Replaces a missing limb and functions like the original. Attach or detach it with a Magic action; another creature cannot remove it against your will.
/magic-item:ruby-of-the-war-mage: Attach to a simple or martial weapon over 10 minutes to use that weapon as your spellcasting focus. Remove it with a Magic action; it also detaches if the weapon is destroyed or attunement ends.
/magic-item:smoldering-armor: While worn, this armor emits harmless, odorless wisps of smoke.
/magic-item:staff-of-adornment: Float up to three Tiny objects weighing at most 1 pound each an inch above the tip. They remain until removed or the staff leaves your possession; while holding it you can make them slowly turn.
/magic-item:sweeping-broom: A Magic action and command word starts the broom sweeping a 20-foot square centered on a visible ground point within 60 feet. Another Magic action stops it.
/magic-item:tankard-of-sobriety: Nonmagical alcoholic drinks consumed from the tankard do not intoxicate the drinker. It does not affect magical liquids or harmful substances.
/magic-item:veteran-s-cane: While holding the cane or its sword form, use a Bonus Action to switch between a walking cane and an ordinary longsword.
/magic-item:wand-of-pyrotechnics: Seven charges, regain 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one as a Magic action for a harmless momentary burst at a visible point within 120 feet, with noise audible 300 feet away. Spending the last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:alchemy-jug: Weighs 12 lb. A Magic action selects one liquid; a Utilize action pours up to 2 gallons per minute. Until dawn, only that liquid is produced, up to its daily maximum: acid 8 oz, basic poison 4 oz, beer 4 gal, honey 1 gal, mayonnaise 2 gal, oil 1 qt, vinegar 2 gal, fresh water 8 gal, salt water 12 gal, or wine 1 gal.
/magic-item:ashen-band-of-courage: Renown 3+ version gives advantage on saves against or ending Charmed and Frightened. Renown 10+ adds +1 AC; 25+ adds +1 to saves; 50+ replaces the condition advantage with immunity to both conditions while retaining the other bonuses.
/magic-item:ashen-band-of-vengeance: Renown 3+ grants +2 ranged weapon damage and ignores half cover on ranged weapon attacks. At 10+ long range imposes no disadvantage; at 25+ ranged attacks ignore three-quarters cover and ranged weapon maximum range doubles; at 50+ ranged weapon damage dice showing 1 or 2 count as 3.
/magic-item:blossom-rod: Budding: cast Druidcraft or Plant Growth (overgrowth only, once per dawn); a Magic action restores plants in a 5-foot cube within 15 feet for 1d4 days. Flowering form: Insect Plague once per dawn using your spell DC. Somniferous form: a once-per-dawn 30-foot pollen emanation: chosen creatures make DC 17 Constitution saves or fall unconscious for 1 hour, ending on damage or an adjacent creature’s action; sleepless and Exhaustion-immune creatures succeed automatically.
/magic-item:cap-of-vanishing: Three charges, fully restored at dawn. A Magic action and one charge makes the wearer Invisible for 10 minutes, ending early if the cap is removed or the wearer attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell.
/magic-item:dispelling-ammunition: On dealing damage, ends ongoing spells of level 3 or lower on the target. The ammunition then becomes nonmagical.
/magic-item:enspelled-staff: Contains one spell of level 8 or lower, chosen at creation. Six charges; spend one to cast the spell, regain 1d6 at dawn. Spending the last charge risks losing magic on a d20 roll of 1. Spell levels cantrip–2 use DC 13/+5; level 3–4 DC 15/+7; level 5–6 DC 17/+9; level 7–8 DC 18/+10. Rarity rises with spell level.
/magic-item:gloves-of-thievery: Invisible while worn; grants +5 to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.
/magic-item:hag-eye: Three charges, fully restored at dawn; spend one to cast Darkvision on yourself or See Invisibility. A creating coven’s hag can use a Magic action and Concentration to see through it on the same plane. A coven can have only one, created through a one-hour rite involving all three hags.
/magic-item:hat-of-vortexes: Three charges, restored at dawn. Spend one with a Magic action to create a 10-foot cube vortex originating from you for 1 hour; its area is difficult terrain.
/magic-item:idol-of-good-fortunes: Blemished: cast Augury once per dawn. Tarnished: +1 AC while attuned and a Magic action converts a touched nonmagical trade bar or gem into equivalent coinage. Golden: cast Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn while holding it.
/magic-item:keyholes-dagger: Three-keyhole dagger grants +1 attack and damage and can become a handaxe or mace during an Attack action until your next turn; use Strength or Dexterity for both rolls. Ten-keyhole version grants +2 and can become any simple melee weapon. Many-keyhole version grants +3, adds battleaxe, longsword, rapier, scimitar and warhammer forms, and permits one missed attack reroll per dawn.
/magic-item:martialist-s-quarterstaff: Four charges, regain 1d4 at dawn. Spend two to cast Searing Smite (DC 13); one during an Attack action grants thrown range 20/60 and return to hand through your next turn; or spend one on a melee attack for advantage and, on a hit, a DC 13 Strength save against Prone.
/magic-item:necklace-of-the-beastly-fami: Cast Find Familiar once per dawn. A Magic action transforms your familiar within 60 feet for 10 minutes into a gemstone-dependent beast: giant octopus, giant scorpion, hippopotamus, mammoth, or tyrannosaurus rex. It keeps its alignment, personality, type, HP and Hit Dice, gains temporary HP equal to the beast’s HP, and reverts when those temporary HP are gone.
/magic-item:pipes-of-pestilence: A Magic action summons a friendly Swarm of Corrupted Rats within 60 feet. Continue playing as a Magic action each round to control it; when control ends the swarm vanishes and the pipes cannot be used again until dawn.
/magic-item:potion-of-fire-breath: For up to 1 hour after drinking, use a Bonus Action to breathe fire at a target within 30 feet, up to three times. DC 13 Dexterity save: 4d6 fire damage on failure, half on success.
/magic-item:potion-of-tirelessness: For 24 hours, you need no sleep and magic cannot put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours of conscious quiet focus.
/magic-item:reliquary-of-dawn: While wearing the talisman, you are immune to the effects of Eventide.
/magic-item:repulsion-shield: Grants +1 AC while wielded. Four charges, regain 1d4 at dawn; when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, use a Reaction and one charge to push it up to 15 feet directly away.
/magic-item:ring-of-dedicated-focus: After failing a Constitution save to maintain Concentration, expend and roll up to two Hit Dice and add their total to the save.
/magic-item:sending-stones: Touch one of the matched stones to cast Sending to the bearer of the other. If nobody bears the other, you learn that without casting. One casting per pair per dawn; destruction of one makes the other nonmagical.
/magic-item:silencing-satchel: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action spend one to target a visible creature within 60 feet: DC 15 Charisma save or its mouth is sealed for 1 minute, preventing verbal spells, potions, food and drink. Repeat the save at each turn’s end.
/magic-item:spiked-shield: During an Attack action, bash a target within 5 feet using Strength and proficiency; a hit deals 2d6 plus Strength piercing. Once per dawn a Magic action fires spikes in a 30-foot cone: DC 13 Dexterity save, 3d6 piercing on failure or half on success.
/magic-item:sword-of-vengeance: +1 attack and damage. Attunement curses you to keep the sword and imposes disadvantage on attacks with other weapons. When another creature damages you in combat while carrying it, DC 15 Wisdom save or attack that creature until either of you reaches 0 HP or you cannot reach it. Banishment expels the spirit and leaves a normal +1 weapon.
/magic-item:thespian-s-playbill: While holding it, add your Charisma modifier, minimum +1, to Intelligence checks made as part of the Study action.
/magic-item:wand-of-enthralling: Four charges, regain 1d4 at dawn. Spend one while holding the wand to cast Enthrall with save DC 15.
/magic-item:wave-swept-weapon: Barnacled grants +1 attack and damage and a Magic action can salt up to a gallon of liquid. Aquatic raises the bonus to +2 and grants underwater breathing and 30-foot swim speed while held; it also emits 5 feet bright and 5 feet dim light. Ascendant raises the bonus to +3 and grants 30-foot fly speed while held.
/magic-item:amulet-of-retributive-healin: Three charges; regain 1d4 at dawn. When you restore HP to one other creature, spend one charge to regain the same amount yourself.
/magic-item:armor-1-2-or-3: While worn, this armor grants a +1, +2, or +3 bonus to AC, according to its rarity.
/magic-item:brooch-of-the-elements: Three charges, restored at dawn. When a visible creature within 60 feet hits and deals attack damage, use a Reaction and one charge to change one damage type to acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.
/magic-item:dazzling-weapon: +1 attack and damage. Toggle 30 feet bright plus 30 feet dim light with a Bonus Action. Four charges, regain 1d4 at dawn; after being hit, use a Reaction and one charge to force the attacker to make a DC 15 Constitution save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.
/magic-item:dream-weaver: While the tapestry is hung and you are within 30 feet, study it for an hour during a long rest and record a d20 roll at rest’s end; before your next long rest, substitute it for one of your D20 Tests before rolling. It records the identity of a Dream spell’s caster and grants advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves while you are Unconscious.
/magic-item:fork-of-eddy-summoning: Once per dawn, a Magic action summons a friendly Eldritch Eddy in the nearest available space. It obeys commands and acts immediately after you; it disappears after 1 hour, on death, or when dismissed as a Bonus Action.
/magic-item:iron-bands-of-bilarro: Once per dawn, throw with a Magic action at a visible Huge or smaller creature within 60 feet, using Dexterity plus proficiency for the ranged attack. A hit Restrains until released with a Bonus Action. A creature touching the bands can attempt DC 20 Athletics to destroy them; a failed creature cannot retry for 24 hours.
/magic-item:magen-handbell: Ring as a Magic action to summon an obedient Terran Magen within 30 feet for up to 1 hour; dismiss it as a Bonus Action. Reuse after 1d6 days. When it starts a turn Bloodied, a d6 roll of 6 makes it berserk; a DC 15 Persuasion Influence action by a bell holder restores control.
/magic-item:mythallar-cloak: Ten charges, regain 1d10 at dawn. Spend one as a Bonus Action for up to 1 minute of 30-foot flying speed and hover; once per turn an attack hit that deals damage can add 1d4 radiant. You fall if airborne when the effect ends.
/magic-item:potion-of-invulnerability: Grants resistance to all damage for 1 minute after drinking.
/magic-item:scarlet-spellbook: While attuned, use as a spellbook and Arcane Focus. Arcane Recovery also heals 2d6 plus half your Wizard level, rounded down. Memorize Spell can replace one additional prepared level 1+ Wizard spell with a level 1+ spell in the book.
/magic-item:secret-keeper-s-circlet: Once per dawn, set a trigger as a Magic action. If it occurs within 24 hours, the wearer forgets everything from setting the trigger until it occurs; only Wish can restore those memories.
/magic-item:stormwalker-s-cloak: Grants resistance to lightning and thunder. Three charges restored at dawn; spend one to cast Hellish Rebuke (DC 13), dealing lightning or thunder instead of fire.
/magic-item:wand-of-misdirection: Four charges, regain 1d4 at dawn. Spend one while holding the wand to cast Mislead.
/magic-item:windskiff: Three charges, restored at dawn. A Magic action and one charge transforms the jewelry into a Medium sail vehicle for 1 hour or until its command word. It has AC 12, 30 HP, speed 40 feet, hovers above surfaces, glides 5 feet horizontally per foot descended, and prevents falling damage to itself and riders.
/magic-item:crown-of-the-ogre-king: A Magic action produces a belch audible to 300 feet. Creatures in a 20-foot cone make DC 17 Strength saves or are pushed up to 20 feet and knocked Prone. Attunement curses the wearer with extreme hunger and poor manners, tripling daily food needs until Remove Curse or similar magic.
/magic-item:flask-of-the-titans: Increases current and maximum HP by 30 for 1 hour after drinking.
/magic-item:lute-of-thunderous-thumping: Functions as a magic club dealing an extra 2d8 thunder damage on a hit. A Bard singing or humming can use Charisma instead of Strength for melee attack rolls with it.
/magic-item:philosopher-s-stone: Only its creator can use it effectively. It serves as a spellcasting focus; an hour transmutes one kind of crafting resource into another of equal value. For potion effect dice, roll twice and choose either result; potion durations are doubled.
/magic-item:potion-of-vitality: Removes all Exhaustion levels and the Poisoned condition. For 24 hours, each Hit Point Die spent restores its maximum possible HP.
/magic-item:rod-of-the-sleepwalker: Cast Dominate Monster once per dawn (DC 17), with Concentration up to 8 hours. Sleepless or Exhaustion-immune creatures automatically succeed on the save; affected creatures forget the spell’s duration afterward.
/magic-item:spirit-board: Three charges, regain one at dawn. With the planchette on the board, touch it for 1 minute to cast Augury (one charge) or Commune (three charges).
/magic-item:tramontane-armor: +1 AC; snow, ice, rubble and undergrowth difficult terrain costs no extra movement. Once per dawn activate for 1 minute with a Magic action; as a Bonus Action, chosen creatures in a 20-foot emanation make DC 15 Strength saves or are pulled up to 20 feet and Grappled (escape DC 15).
/magic-item:apparatus-of-kwalish: A 500-pound, Large vehicle for two Medium or smaller occupants: AC 20, 200 HP, speed and swim 30 feet with legs extended, immune to poison and psychic. Closed cabin supplies 10 creature-hours of air and tolerates 900-foot depth; deeper water deals 2d6 bludgeoning per minute. A pilot uses levers to move, light, open shutters, and attack or grapple with claws (+8, 2d6 bludgeoning or escape DC 15).
/magic-item:cloak-of-invisibility: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. A Magic action and one charge while wearing it makes you Invisible for 1 hour; lowering or removing the hood ends the effect.
/magic-item:diamond-staff: +3 quarterstaff with 20 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn; last charge destroys it on a d20 roll of 1. Grants Arcana advantage; one charge lights 40 feet bright and 40 dim for a minute. Cast Detect Magic, Light or Tongues free; Identify 1, Knock 2, True Seeing 3, Legend Lore 5, Maze 8 charges. On a melee hit spend two charges for DC 17 Constitution save or Stunned through your next turn.
/magic-item:invincible-s-reins: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend one to cast level-5 Find Steed, summoning Invincible as an Undead steed dealing necrotic damage. Once per long rest its Bonus Action lets steed and rider move through creatures and objects for a turn; ending inside an object deals 1d10 force to each. The sentient mount can refuse summons amid conflicts of loyalty.
/magic-item:moonblade: A sentient sword chooses its bearer; rejection curses D20 Tests with disadvantage for 24 hours or until cured. Acceptance attunes until death or destruction. Its first rune gives +1 attack and damage; further runes add properties such as higher bonus up to +3, force damage, returning thrown range, expanded critical range, blinding flash, spell storage, or a spectral ally. Other users wield it as a nonmagical weapon.
/magic-item:scroll-of-titan-summoning: A Magic action summons the scroll’s named titan in a visible space within 1 mile. It is hostile to all other creatures and remains until reduced to 0 HP. If the space is too small, the summoning fails and the scroll is wasted.
/magic-item:sundial-of-eternal-dusk: While held, tells time, serves as a spellcasting focus, creates dim light in your space, and grants radiant resistance. Twenty charges, regain 1d6+3 at dawn; cast spells at DC 19: Toll the Dead 0, Darkness 2, Fear, Hunger of Hadar or Summon Undead 3, Dimension Door, Black Tentacles or Phantasmal Killer 4, True Seeing 6. Dimension Door must end in dim light or darkness.
/magic-item:tiny-abomination-in-a-jar: An attack d20 roll of 11 while carrying it creates a Mote of Anger, lasting until a long rest and granting +2 damage. Four motes trigger an immediate weapon attack with advantage; all four bonuses apply, then the motes disappear whether the attack hits or misses.
/magic-item:traveler-s-pearl: While holding it, use a command word to cast Teleport once per dawn.
/magic-item:blackrazor: +3 attack and damage; while held, immunity to Charmed and Frightened and 30-foot blindsight. Reducing a non-Construct, non-Undead creature to 0 HP kills it and consumes its soul, granting temporary HP equal to its maximum; Wish is needed to revive it. Hitting Undead damages you 1d10 necrotic and heals it 1d10. The sentient sword can cast Haste on you once per dawn without Concentration and demands souls.
/magic-item:calimemnon-crystal: While attuned, use as an Arcane Focus, fly 30 feet and hover, and cast Create or Destroy Water, Enlarge/Reduce, self-only Invisibility, and Major Image (DC 18). A toggleable 20-foot cold aura deals 2d6 cold at most once per turn to other creatures entering, ending a turn in, or entered by it. Once per dawn fire six rays within 60 feet, each healing 2d6+2 or dealing 6d6+6 radiant on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save, half on success. Has four random artifact properties.
/magic-item:doomhammer: +3 attack and damage and an extra 1d8 lightning on a hit. While held, Rage doubles speed and grants an extra one-attack Attack action each turn; you can walk on lava unharmed, use a Reaction to negate lightning damage to a visible creature within 60 feet, and cast Wind Walk once per dawn. Has four random artifact properties.
/magic-item:frostmourne: +3 attack and damage and extra 2d12 cold on a hit. Creatures reduced to 0 HP by it die and their souls remain trapped until it is destroyed. Attunement permanently changes your type to Undead and alignment to Neutral Evil, and lets the Lich King perceive through you and communicate across planes. A Paladin’s aura grants chosen Undead advantage on attacks and saves and allies cold immunity. Has three random properties.
/magic-item:orb-of-damara: While attuned, fly 60 feet with hover; a Magic action breathes a 15-foot cone of chosen acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: DC 18 Dexterity save, 6d6 damage or half. A toggleable 20-foot aura can Frighten enemies on DC 18 Wisdom saves. Six charges, regain 1d4+2 at dawn; cast spells at DC 18/+10, including level-9 Summon Dragon for four charges. Swallowing the orb permanently transforms you into a DM-controlled adult chromatic dragon.
/magic-item:shadowmourne: +3 attack and damage; melee hits deal extra 1d12 necrotic and grant temporary HP equal to that damage. Creatures other than Constructs reduced to 0 HP are slain and their souls devoured; Wish is needed to restore them, and their maximum HP becomes your temporary HP. With at least 12 temporary HP, sacrifice all as a Bonus Action to deal that amount in a 15-foot emanation (DC 21 Constitution save for half) and gain advantage on attacks and saves through your next turn.
/magic-item:spirit-binding-censer: Ten charges, regain 1d6 at dawn. Cast Bless (1), Dispel Magic or Remove Curse (3), Banishment (4), or Circle of Power (5), DC 18. Once per dawn, a Magic action emits lightly obscuring smoke for 1 hour in a 30-foot emanation, giving chosen creatures Protection from Evil and Good within it. Capture one dying creature’s soul within 30 feet for up to 100 years, preventing its revival until released or the censer is destroyed.
/magic-item:twin-blades-of-azzinoth: Each blade grants +3 attack and damage and deals an extra 2d8 psychic to Fiends, ignoring resistance and immunity. Hitting the same creature with both in a turn forces a DC 18 Wisdom save or Stuns it through its next turn. As a Magic action, throw one within 30 feet to summon a Devil-form Summon Fiend for 1 minute; that blade cannot do so again for 7 days.
/magic-item:wave: +3 attack and damage; a natural 20 adds 21 necrotic damage. While held, grants initiative advantage and underwater breathing. Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn; spend one to cast Dominate Beast (DC 20) on a Beast with a swim speed. Cast level-9 Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn. The sentient weapon promotes worship of sea gods.
/magic-item:boots-of-false-tracks: While worn, the boots can leave tracks resembling any Humanoid of your size.
/magic-item:charlatan-s-die: Choose the result whenever you roll this six-sided die.
/magic-item:clockwork-amulet: Once per dawn, replace the d20 on an attack roll with 10 while wearing the amulet.
/magic-item:dark-shard-amulet: Warlock spellcasting focus. Once per long rest, use a Magic action and DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check to cast an unknown action-casting-time Warlock cantrip; failure wastes the action.
/magic-item:ear-horn-of-hearing: Held to your ear, the horn suppresses the Deafened condition.
/magic-item:ensorcelled-missive: After writing, seal the sheet with a Magic action and a word or phrase. Anyone unsealing it without that phrase sees unintelligible writing.
/magic-item:evergreen-fertilizer: Sprinkle on soil around a nonmagical plant to keep it healthy for 365 days.
/magic-item:heward-s-handy-spice-pouch: 10 charges; recover 1d6 + 4 at dawn. A Magic action and 1 charge produce a pinch of any nonmagical seasoning, enough for one meal.
/magic-item:instrument-of-illusions: While playing, a Magic action produces harmless, visibly illusory and silent images within 5 feet, or 15 feet for a Bard. They end when playing stops.
/magic-item:lucky-foot: On a natural 1 on an ability check or saving throw, reroll and use the new result; the foot is consumed.
/magic-item:mechanical-wonder: Wind with its key for 1 minute, using the Utilize action each turn. Domestic and flying versions are allied creatures that obey verbal commands and are destroyed at 0 HP. Gyrocopter operates 8 hours: Huge, AC 14, 50 HP, speed 5 feet, fly 20 feet, 2,000-pound cargo limit; eight cords permit gliding. Mobility version operates 24 hours and raises speed to 30 feet; others cannot remove it without consent.
/magic-item:mythallar-bracelet: Three beads. Pluck one as a Magic action for advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks for 1 minute; the bead disappears. The bracelet becomes nonmagical after all three are used.
/magic-item:perfume-of-bewitching: One use. Apply as a Magic action for advantage on Charisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks to influence creatures within 5 feet for 1 hour.
/magic-item:pole-of-collapsing: As a Magic action, collapse the pole to a 1-foot rod or extend it again. Weight is unchanged and available space limits extension.
/magic-item:potion-of-healing: Drink or administer within 5 feet as a Bonus Action. Healing restores 2d4 + 2 HP; greater 4d4 + 4; superior 8d4 + 8; supreme 10d4 + 20.
/magic-item:rival-coin: One charge, restored at dawn. Toss as a Magic action: even roll targets a visible creature within 60 feet (DC 13 Wisdom; 2d4 Psychic damage and disadvantage on its next attack before the end of its next turn; half damage on success); odd roll deals you 1d4 Psychic damage.
/magic-item:shield-of-expression: Change the face on the shield as a Bonus Action while bearing it.
/magic-item:sniper-s-bracelet: Transform the weapon into a bracelet or back with a Magic action; it cannot attack as a bracelet. If ammunition is lacking, each ranged attack creates magic ammunition that vanishes after hit or miss.
/magic-item:staff-of-birdcalls: 10 charges; regain 1d6 + 4 at dawn. A Magic action and 1 charge produce a birdcall audible 120 feet away. Spending the last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:sylvan-talon: While carried, you and Fey understand one another’s nonwritten communication. Cast Message as a Magic action once per dawn.
/magic-item:trick-weapon: Touch and transform the weapon into its assigned mundane item or back as a Magic action. It cannot attack in the mundane form.
/magic-item:walloping-ammunition: A creature hit must succeed on a DC 10 Strength save or fall Prone.
/magic-item:adamantine-weapon: A hit against an object is automatically a critical hit.
/magic-item:ammunition-1-2-or-3: Adds +1, +2, or +3 to attack and damage rolls according to rarity. A piece loses its magic after it hits.
/magic-item:ashen-band-of-destruction: Renown 3: +1 spell attacks and spell save DC; renown 10: +2; renown 25: +3 and spell damage dice of 1 count as 2. Renown 50 adds 2 to the specified spellcasting ability, maximum 30, and +3 to one damage roll of each spell.
/magic-item:ashen-band-of-wisdom: Renown 3: healing dice of 1 count as 2. Renown 10 also lets another creature within 30 feet regain half the HP restored to one creature. Renown 25 extends eligible non-attack touch spells to 30 feet. Renown 50 also adds 2 to the specified spellcasting ability, maximum 30.
/magic-item:boon-companion-s-bands: Paired bands protect the other wearer from your area spell or feature: they automatically succeed on its save and take no damage on a successful-save half-damage effect. Once per pair per dawn. Destroying one destroys the other.
/magic-item:cap-of-water-breathing: Underwater, use a Magic action to make a breathing bubble around your head. It lasts until you leave the water or remove the cap.
/magic-item:driftglobe: Command within 60 feet to produce Light or Daylight; Daylight once per dawn. A Magic action makes the lit globe hover up to 5 feet above ground and follow if you move more than 60 feet away. Obstruction causes it to settle and go dark. Weighs 1 pound.
/magic-item:enspelled-weapon: Contains a level 8 or lower Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy, or Transmutation spell. Six charges, recovering 1d6 at dawn; cast the bound spell for 1 charge. Cantrip/level 1: DC 13, +5; level 2: DC 13, +5; levels 3–4: DC 15, +7; levels 5–6: DC 17, +9; levels 7–8: DC 18, +10. Rarity rises with spell level.
/magic-item:goading-ammunition: On a damaging hit, DC 13 Charisma save or target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Loses magic after hitting.
/magic-item:harkon-s-bite: +1 to ability checks and saves while worn. Curse persists until Harkon Lukas dies; during a full moon you become a werewolf serving him under DM control.
/magic-item:hearthstone: A 1-minute Magic action teleports you to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the preset destination. Set a destination at an inn or DM-approved location using a Magic action. One Hearthstone does not count against your attunement limit.
/magic-item:instrument-of-the-bards: Play to cast each listed spell once per dawn using your spellcasting ability and DC. All grant Fly, Invisibility, Levitate, and Protection from Evil and Good. Doss: Animal Friendship, fire Protection from Energy, Protection from Poison; Fochlucan: Entangle, Faerie Fire, Shillelagh, Speak with Animals; Mac-Fuirmidh: Barkskin, Cure Wounds, Fog Cloud; Canaith: level 3 Cure Wounds, Dispel Magic, lightning Protection from Energy; Cli: Stone Shape, Wall of Fire, Wind Wall; Anstruth: level 5 Cure Wounds, Ice Storm, Wall of Thorns; Ollamh: Confusion, Control Weather, Fire Storm. Unattuned players risk 2d4 Psychic damage on DC 15 Wisdom failure.
/magic-item:magewright-s-gloves: While worn, count as two characters for crafting nonmagical items using alchemist, brewer, calligrapher, cartographer, glassblower, or jeweler tools.
/magic-item:mind-sharpener: Four charges, recovering 1d4 at dawn. When you fail a Constitution save to maintain concentration, use a reaction and one charge to succeed instead.
/magic-item:orb-of-divination-detection: Glows green for the duration when a Divination spell targets you. Functions as an Arcane Focus.
/magic-item:poison-soaked-kukri: Once per dawn, a Bonus Action coats the dagger for 1 minute or until it hits. The hit creature makes a DC 13 Constitution save; on failure it takes 2d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute.
/magic-item:potion-of-pugilism: Drinking gives unarmed strikes an extra 1d6 Force damage on hits for 10 minutes.
/magic-item:quaal-s-feather-token: Single-use variants: Anchor holds a vessel in place for 24 hours; Bird summons a nonattacking roc-like carrier (500 pounds at 16 mph or 1,000 at half speed); Fan boosts a sailing ship 5 mph for 8 hours; Swan Boat creates a 6 mph boat for 24 hours; Tree creates a permanent 60-foot oak outdoors; Whip attacks at +9 for 1d6 + 5 Force, moves 20 feet, and lasts up to 1 hour.
/magic-item:reliquary-of-twilight: While worn, grants immunity to the effects of Morningtide.
/magic-item:returning-weapon: +1 to attack and damage; returns to your hand immediately after a ranged attack.
/magic-item:rod-of-the-pact-keeper: While held, adds its rarity-based +1, +2, or +3 bonus to Warlock spell attacks and save DCs. Once per long rest, use a Magic action to recover one spell slot.
/magic-item:sentinel-shield: While held, grants advantage on initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.
/magic-item:spell-refueling-ring: Once per dawn, use a Bonus Action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower.
/magic-item:staff-of-skulls: Ominous: cast Chill Touch using your spell attack bonus, gain Intimidation advantage, and shed 5-foot dim light. Chattering: reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack by a visible creature within 30 feet. Pulverizing: once per dawn, Magic action targets a visible Humanoid; DC 17 Constitution, 10d8 Necrotic and Prone on failure, half damage on success.
/magic-item:sync-ring: Choose a blank book when attuning. Writing with the ring hand appears in that book; magic writing is copied without magic. Attunement ends if pages run out or the book remains on another plane over 24 hours.
/magic-item:thief-s-thimble: Absorbs damage from traps you trigger. It has 30 HP; at 0 it breaks and remaining damage transfers to you.
/magic-item:wand-of-freshness: Four charges; regain 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Spend 1 charge to cast Purify Food and Drink.
/magic-item:weapon-1-2-or-3: Adds +1, +2, or +3 to attack and damage rolls according to rarity.
/magic-item:arcane-chantelaine: Six spectral keys each cast Arcane Lock on a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch as a Magic action. Each key vanishes after use; the clasp vanishes after the sixth.
/magic-item:bellows-of-strangulation: Six charges; regain 1d6 + 1 at dawn. Magic action: 1 charge targets a creature within 60 feet, or 3 charges target a 30-foot cone; DC 15 Constitution or Incapacitated for 1 minute, repeating at turn ends. Five charges cast Cloudkill (DC 17). Last charge risks destruction on d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:cube-of-summoning: Once per dawn, wind as a Magic action to cast a random level 5 Summon Aberration, Beast, Construct, Dragon, Elemental, or Fey spell without concentration; save DC 17, attack +9.
/magic-item:defias-leather: While worn, advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide behind stone; cast Meld into Stone once per dawn.
/magic-item:elixir-of-health: Drinking cures magical contagions and ends Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned on you.
/magic-item:goggles-of-foe-finding: While worn, ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover.
/magic-item:life-sapping-blade: +1 attack and damage; hit adds 2d4 Necrotic damage and prevents healing until the end of the target’s next turn. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the weapon dies immediately and requires Resurrection or True Resurrection to return.
/magic-item:mage-s-manacle: Once per dawn, Magic action targets a Grappled or Incapacitated Large or smaller creature within 5 feet. DC 15 Dexterity failure binds and Restrains it for 8 hours or until released; it moves with you. Disintegrate destroys the manacle.
/magic-item:namer-s-needle: +1 attack and damage. On a hit, DC 15 Wisdom failure compels the target to reveal its name; success grants 24-hour immunity. Once per dawn, say or sign the target’s name on a hit to make it a critical hit.
/magic-item:prismatic-rune: After each long rest choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Six charges, recovering 1d6 at dawn; spend 1 when casting a damaging spell to change its damage type to the chosen type.
/magic-item:scholar-s-anchoring-bangle: For proficient Intelligence skill checks using Study, treat rolls of 9 or less as 10. Once per dawn, use a reaction to succeed on a failed concentration Constitution save.
/magic-item:shadowfang: +1 attack and damage. Under the night sky the sword transforms and adds 2d6 Necrotic damage on a hit; it reverts at dawn or indoors.
/magic-item:tentacle-rod: Magic action makes three melee attacks at +9 against creatures visible within 15 feet, each dealing 1d6 Psychic. Three hits on one target force DC 15 Dexterity or Restrain it; it takes 3d6 Psychic at each turn start and repeats the save at turn end. Ends if released, out of range, or you become Incapacitated.
/magic-item:wand-of-slumber: Seven charges; regain 1d6 + 1 at dawn. Cast Catnap for 3 charges or Sleep for 1 (DC 15). Last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:bauble-of-true-blood: Nine charges; regain 1d6 at dawn or expend Hit Point Dice during a short or long rest for one charge each. Cast Cure Wounds at a spell level equal to charges spent, maximum 9.
/magic-item:energy-bow: +1 attack and damage; creates luminous arrows dealing Force instead of Piercing. A restraint shot requires DC 15 Strength or Restrains for 1 minute, escapable with DC 20 Athletics action. Magic action teleports an eligible willing Medium or smaller creature or small unattended object from within 60 feet to within 10 feet, or creates a 60-foot ladder for 1 minute.
/magic-item:fragment-of-frozen-bone: Magic action and command word summon Boneshard as a World of Warcraft undead companion. It ends when dismissed, damaged, or another companion is summoned.
/magic-item:niko-s-mace: Six charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. Spend 1 to cast Summon Celestial with +9 spell attack bonus.
/magic-item:potion-of-greater-invisibili: Drinking grants the Invisible condition for 1 hour.
/magic-item:quarterstaff-of-the-acrobat: +2 attack and damage. Bonus action changes it between quarterstaff, 6-inch rod, and 10-foot pole, or toggles 10-foot dim light. Staff or pole grants Acrobatics advantage. Staff can be thrown 30/120 feet and returns; once per short or long rest, reaction grants +5 AC against one triggering hit.
/magic-item:shield-of-the-cavalier: Adds +2 AC beyond the normal shield bonus. Attack with it using Strength and proficiency: 2d6 + 2 + Strength Force damage, push 10 feet and optionally knock a same-size or smaller creature Prone. Once per dawn, reaction creates an immobile 5-foot protective field against an attack or area effect, concentration up to 1 minute; nothing passes through it.
/magic-item:staff-of-the-lost: +1 quarterstaff with 3 nonrenewing charges. Spend 1 to cast Maze (DC 18) or Teleport; loses magic at zero. Curse prevents parting, obscures north, and imposes navigation Survival disadvantage. Each charge has a 1-in-20 chance of summoning 1d4 hostile minotaurs.
/magic-item:vithrak-gaze-of-the-deadman: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. Spend 1 as a Magic action to learn a visible creature’s resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities within 120 feet.
/magic-item:aviana-s-feather: Magic action creates wings granting 80-foot fly speed, disadvantage on opportunity attacks provoked by flying away, and a 60-foot-per-round descent while falling. Wings persist until dismissed with a Magic action or attunement ends.
/magic-item:crystal-ball-of-ominous-port: While touching, cast Hex or Scrying (DC 17). Once per dawn, reaction changes a successful D20 Test by a visible creature within 60 feet into a 1.
/magic-item:efreeti-chain: +3 AC, immunity to Fire, knowledge of Primordial, and ability to stand and move on molten rock.
/magic-item:judgment-armor: While worn, Detect Evil and Good and Protection from Evil and Good operate without concentration. A Paladin extends the protection to chosen creatures in their Aura of Protection.
/magic-item:ring-of-maddening-whispers: Once per dawn cast level 9 Dominate Monster (DC 19). Each successful save against it deals you 5d10 Psychic damage and Incapacitates you until the end of your next turn.
/magic-item:staff-of-light-and-shadow: Choose form at dawn. Anathema grants Necrotic resistance and, when casting a level 1–5 Necromancy spell, a d6 roll above its level avoids expending the slot. Benediction grants Radiant resistance and treats healing spells as cast one slot level higher.
/magic-item:sword-of-answering: +3 attack and damage. When a creature in reach damages you, reaction makes a melee attack with advantage; this attack’s damage ignores the target’s resistance and immunity.
/magic-item:tome-of-the-dragon: Transforms an adult or ancient dragon into a dracolich. A qualifying dragon or spellcaster with two level 5 slots conducts a 180-day ritual divided by qualifying participants, with 80,000 GP in supplies; dragon-led ritual halves time and cost. At completion each participant takes 12d6 Necrotic; those reduced to 0 die and become zombies. The resulting dracolich is independent.
/magic-item:ashbringer: +3 attack and damage; hits add 1d10 Fire, or 3d10 against Undead. At 0 HP, corrupted form grants 20 temporary HP; true form can explode the corpse, forcing chosen creatures within 10 feet to save DC 18 Constitution or be Blinded until the end of their next turn. Sentient; state changes with legendary wickedness or heroism.
/magic-item:book-of-exalted-deeds: Attunement grants Charmed and Frightened immunity and Psychic resistance; 80 hours of study makes those benefits permanent, adds 2 Wisdom (maximum 24), upgrades expended spell slots by one level, and grants a dismissible halo: 10 feet bright and 10 feet dim light, Persuasion advantage, and nearby Fiends and Undead attack you at disadvantage. Benefits require ongoing good conduct. Hostile readers risk 24d6 unavoidable Radiant damage.
/magic-item:crown-of-horns: Curse binds the wearer, changes alignment to Neutral Evil, and transforms them into a DM-controlled lich after 365 days; each use of Cone of Undeath or Myrkul’s Hand adds a cumulative 10% chance of immediate transformation. Grants Necrotic immunity, 60-foot fear aura (DC 16), 60-foot cone for 4d8 Necrotic (DC 18), Power Word Kill once per dawn, and Teleport once per seven days. Humanoids killed rise as commanded undead.
/magic-item:ebonbane: +3 attack and damage; hits on Celestials or Humanoids add 3d6 Necrotic. While held, advantage on saves against spells and magic. Leaving the Shadowlands ends attunement and returns the sword there. After three days without killing a Celestial or Humanoid, DC 17 Charisma at dawn: success deals 8d8 Force; failure allows domination until its demand is met.
/magic-item:helm-of-domination: Attuning requires DC 18 Charisma: success deals 10d6 Psychic; failure gives the Lich King control. Wearer becomes Neutral Evil and cannot voluntarily part or end attunement. Grants 120-foot Truesight; once daily DC 20 spellcasting check commands the Scourge. Eight charges, regain 1d4 + 4 at dawn: Animate Dead 1, Clairvoyance 2, Dream 4, Speak with Dead 1, Telepathy 5, Word of Recall 5; DC 18.
/magic-item:orb-of-dragonkind: DC 15 Charisma determines control; failure charms and binds attunement, letting the orb use Suggestion at DC 18. Seven charges, regain 1d4 + 3 at dawn: level 9 Cure Wounds 4, Daylight 1, Death Ward 2, Detect Magic 0, Scrying 3 (DC 18). Once hourly, call chromatic dragons within 40 miles. AC 20; only a +3 weapon or Disintegrate damages it.
/magic-item:shadow-s-edge: +3 attack and damage. Reducing a non-Construct to 0 kills it and devours its soul, granting temporary HP equal to half its maximum; only Wish can restore it. Separate infusions grant once-daily bonus-action spells on a hit: Blight, Black Tentacles, or Cone of Cold, each DC 19, plus random properties.
/magic-item:sulfuras-hand-of-ragnaros: +3 attack and damage; hits add 1d10 Fire and cause burning for 1d10 Fire at each turn start. Each effect once per dawn: boil water within 1 mile for 1 minute (2d10 Fire), cast Incendiary Cloud (DC 18), or erupt lava in a 10-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder within 120 feet (DC 18 Dexterity; 9d10 Fire plus 9d10 Bludgeoning, half on success).
/magic-item:universal-pantograph: Closing the box around a nonmagical item produces a duplicate. A Magic action enlarges it for a Medium creature; closing it with a creature and 100 GP diamond dust casts Clone. The box remains closed for 120 days while the clone grows, then releases it. The inert clone lasts indefinitely without a vessel.
/magic-item:whelm: +3 attack and damage; thrown range 60/180 and returns, adding 1d8 Force on a ranged hit, or 4d8 against Constructs, Elementals, and Giants. Once per dawn, ground shock wave forces chosen creatures within 60 feet to DC 20 Constitution or Stunned for 1 minute, repeating saves at turn ends. Detects concealed doors within 30 feet; casts Detect Evil and Good and Locate Object once each per dawn.
/magic-item:bead-of-nourishment: One bead provides the nourishment of a day of rations.
/magic-item:candle-of-the-deep: Burns underwater without extinguishing and otherwise provides ordinary candlelight and heat.
/magic-item:cloak-of-billowing: While worn, a Bonus Action makes the cloak billow for 1 minute.
/magic-item:clothes-of-mending: The outfit repairs ordinary wear automatically, but cannot restore destroyed pieces.
/magic-item:dictation-quill: With paper and ink, a Magic action and command start transcription of speech or signing at 25 words per minute in the language used. Stops after 1 hour, supplies run out, or a command ends it.
/magic-item:elocutionist-s-lexicon: While holding the dictionary, a Magic action opens it to the word you are trying to recall.
/magic-item:ersatz-eye: Replaces a missing eye and provides normal vision. Insert or remove it with a Magic action; it cannot be removed against your will while you live.
/magic-item:hat-of-vermin: Three charges, all restored at dawn. A Magic action and one charge summon a bat, frog, or rat in the hat. It is indifferent and uncontrolled, flees, and disappears after 1 hour or at 0 HP.
/magic-item:homeward-compass: A Magic action sets the compass to your location; its needle points there until reset with another Magic action. It spins when unset or on another plane. Only one location can be recorded.
/magic-item:instrument-of-scribing: Three charges, all restored at dawn. Playing it and using a Magic action and one charge writes up to six words within 30 feet for 24 hours. A Bard may add seven words and make it glow in nonmagical darkness. Dispel Magic erases it.
/magic-item:manifold-tool: A Magic action changes this basic tool into any Artisan’s Tools. You are proficient with the resulting tools.
/magic-item:moon-touched-sword: When drawn in darkness, the sword sheds bright moonlight for 15 feet and dim light another 15 feet.
/magic-item:orb-of-direction: Functions as an Arcane Focus. A Magic action while holding it reveals magnetic north where such a direction exists.
/magic-item:pipe-of-smoke-monsters: A Magic action while smoking creates a creature-shaped puff fitting in a 1-foot cube. Its shape lasts only seconds.
/magic-item:pot-of-awakening: An ordinary shrub grown in the 10-pound pot for 30 days becomes a friendly Awakened Shrub that obeys you and otherwise does nothing. Awakening breaks the pot.
/magic-item:potion-of-mana: Restores one expended spell slot: level 1 for common, levels 1–3 for greater, or levels 1–5 for superior. Choose the slot within the applicable range.
/magic-item:rope-of-mending: This 50-foot rope rejoins touching, unused pieces with a Magic action. Lost or destroyed sections permanently shorten it.
/magic-item:silvered-weapon: On a critical hit against a shape-shifted creature, the silvered weapon adds one weapon damage die.
/magic-item:spell-component-ring: A Magic action stores the material component of one prepared spell, provided the component has no listed cost and is not consumed. While wearing the ring, casting that spell does not require a free hand to access it. Holds one component at a time.
/magic-item:staff-of-flowers: Ten charges; regain 1d6 + 4 at dawn. A Magic action and one charge grow a harmless, nonmagical flower in soil within 5 feet or on the staff. Expending the last charge has a 1-in-20 chance of destroying it.
/magic-item:talking-doll: During a Short Rest within 5 feet, set up to six phrases of at most six words each and their triggers, which must occur within 5 feet. Phrases disappear when attunement ends.
/magic-item:unraveling-cloak: A Magic action unbuttons the hood, leaving a thread for up to 100 miles. Others need a Search action and DC 15 Perception check to see it. Rebutton with a Magic action; teleportation destroys the unwound thread.
/magic-item:wand-of-conducting: Three charges, restored at dawn. A Magic action and one charge produce orchestral music audible 120 feet while waved. Spending the last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:alarm-pylon: A Magic action activates this 5-foot post with a trigger: a spell of a specified school, a creature taking at least 5 damage, or an object taking at least 10. Within 300 feet, the trigger sounds a 10-second alarm audible 300 feet. A Magic action deactivates it.
/magic-item:arcane-battery: A Magic action transfers 1d4 + 1 charges to a touched magic item that normally regains charges daily, consuming the battery’s magic.
/magic-item:ashen-band-of-might: All versions add +1 melee weapon damage. Greater (rare, renown 10) sets Strength to 19 if lower; unmatched (very rare, renown 25) sets it to 21 and treats melee weapon damage dice showing 1 as 2; endless (legendary, renown 50) sets it to 25 and retains the unmatched benefits. Uncommon requires renown 3.
/magic-item:baba-yaga-s-dancing-broom: A Magic action animates the broom; it acts immediately after you and follows mental commands within 30 feet while you are not incapacitated. A Bonus Action returns it to inanimate form and restores its HP. At 0 HP it is destroyed.
/magic-item:boots-of-the-winding-path: While worn, a Bonus Action teleports you up to 15 feet to a visible unoccupied space you occupied earlier in the same turn.
/magic-item:climber-s-ammunition: On striking a solid surface, this ammunition anchors a rope for 1 hour or until dismissed. The rope supports 500 pounds and the ammunition becomes nonmagical when it vanishes. A hit on a creature breaks the ammunition without damage.
/magic-item:enspelled-armor: Contains an Abjuration or Illusion spell of level 8 or lower; six charges, regain 1d6 at dawn, and one charge casts it. Spell level 0–2 uses DC 13/+5; 3–4 DC 15/+7; 5–6 DC 17/+9; 7–8 DC 18/+10. Rarity rises with spell level.
/magic-item:eyes-of-deceit: While worn, these lenses grant +5 to Deception checks.
/magic-item:goblin-jumper-cables: A Magic action and DC 15 Arcana check using Tinker’s Tools can revive a creature dead no more than 1 minute, unless it died of old age, with 1 HP. Failure deals you 2d6 lightning damage. Usable again at dawn.
/magic-item:harper-pin: Choose a Harper persona, alignment and creature type at attunement; detection magic identifies you as that persona. Silver substitutes a prepared thought of at most 25 words, detectable with a Study action and DC 13 Investigation. Gold grants self-cast Nondetection until disabled, removed, or unattuned.
/magic-item:helm-of-awareness: While worn, grants advantage on initiative rolls.
/magic-item:keoghtom-s-ointment: The half-pound jar contains 1d4 + 1 doses. A Utilize action applies or swallows a dose, restoring 2d8 + 2 HP and ending the Poisoned condition for a creature within 5 feet.
/magic-item:mariner-s-armor: Grants a swim speed equal to your speed. If you start your turn underwater at 0 HP, regain 1d4 HP; this healing recharges at dawn.
/magic-item:nature-s-mantle: Functions as a focus for Druid and Ranger spells. While lightly obscured, you can Hide as a Bonus Action even while directly observed.
/magic-item:orb-of-sorcery: A Sorcerer spellcasting focus. A Magic action restores up to 2 expended Sorcery Points, once per dawn.
/magic-item:potion-of-dragon-s-breath: Grants Dragon’s Breath for 1 minute without concentration, save DC 13. Color determines damage: black acid, blue lightning, green poison, red fire, white cold.
/magic-item:potion-of-rejuvenation: Restores HP and one expended spell slot: ordinary 3d4 + 3 and level 1; greater 6d4 + 6 and levels 1–3; superior 9d4 + 9 and levels 1–5. Choose an eligible slot.
/magic-item:quiver-of-ehlonna: Extradimensional compartments hold 60 arrows or bolts, 18 javelin-sized items, and six long items such as bows or spears. The quiver weighs no more than 2 pounds; contents draw normally.
/magic-item:repeating-shot: Grants +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls and ignores Loading. If ammunition is absent, it creates magic ammunition for each ranged attack, which vanishes after the hit or miss.
/magic-item:ring-of-candor: While worn, grants +5 Insight and casts Zone of Truth at DC 13 once per dawn.
/magic-item:saddle-of-the-cavalier: While mounted in the saddle, attacks against your mount have disadvantage and you cannot be involuntarily dismounted. The latter protection is suppressed while incapacitated.
/magic-item:shield-1-2-or-3: Adds +1, +2, or +3 AC according to rarity, in addition to the shield’s normal AC bonus.
/magic-item:spell-slinger-s-puppet: A Bonus Action sends the doll hovering to a visible space within 30 feet for 1 minute; another Bonus Action moves it up to 30 feet within that range or ends the effect. While within 30 feet you can speak, including verbal spell components, through its mouth.
/magic-item:staff-of-the-adder: A Bonus Action animates or reverts the snake head for up to 1 minute. One attack per Attack action uses proficiency plus Wisdom, reach 5 feet, dealing 1d6 piercing plus 3d6 poison. The head has AC 15, 20 HP and poison/psychic immunity; destruction destroys the staff, otherwise reversion restores its HP.
/magic-item:thayan-spell-tattoo: Contains a chosen level 1–3 spell always prepared while attuned. Cast with suitable slots using your spellcasting ability, or DC 13/+5 without one. One free componentless casting causes the tattoo to vanish, as does ending attunement. Creation requires Red Wizard renown 50, Arcana and Calligrapher’s Tools proficiency and the prepared spell.
/magic-item:troll-s-blood-elixir: Drinking restores 2, 4, 6, or 8 HP for ordinary, greater, superior, or supreme versions respectively. For 1 minute, regain the same amount at the start of each turn if you have at least 1 HP.
/magic-item:wand-of-the-war-mage-1-2-or-: While held, grants +1, +2, or +3 to spell attack rolls according to rarity and ignores Half Cover on spell attacks.
/magic-item:wraps-of-unarmed-power: Unarmed strikes gain a rarity-based attack and damage bonus (+1, +2, or +3); choose force or the strike’s normal damage type.
/magic-item:arcanist-s-bestiary: Once per dawn cast Charm Monster at DC 15, with non-Humanoids disadvantaged on the save. Attunement grants proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion, changeable on a Long Rest. Successful Study/Arcana checks on visible aberrations, constructs, elementals, fey, or monstrosities reveal immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities.
/magic-item:blood-amulet: Three charges, regain 1d3 at dawn. When you damage a creature, spend one to add 2d10 necrotic damage and force a DC 15 Constitution save; failure adds one Exhaustion level.
/magic-item:daern-s-instant-fortress: A Magic action transforms the statuette into a 20-foot-square, 30-foot-high tower, pushing creatures and loose objects clear; it shrinks only when empty. Door, walls and roof each have AC 20, 100 HP, immunity to non-siege physical damage and resistance to other damage. Wish restores all HP.
/magic-item:dissuader: A +1 Quarterstaff. Each property recharges at dawn: cast Calm Emotions (DC 15); create a 30-foot aura for 1 minute that can frighten visible creatures on DC 15 Wisdom failures; or react to a creature approaching within 5 feet to push chosen creatures in a 30-foot emanation up to 30 feet on failed DC 15 Strength saves.
/magic-item:experimental-goblin-jetpack: A Magic action activates flight at speed 60 feet for 1 hour or until stopped with another Magic action. You fall if airborne when it stops; it recharges after 1d12 hours.
/magic-item:heward-s-handy-haversack: Two side pouches each hold 200 pounds/25 cubic feet; the central pouch holds 500 pounds/64 cubic feet. It weighs 5 pounds and retrieval uses a Utilize or Bonus Action. Each pouch holds 10 creature-minutes of air. Overloading or piercing destroys it and loses contents; nesting extradimensional containers destroys both and draws nearby creatures into the Astral Plane.
/magic-item:mage-breaker: A +1 weapon. A concentrating creature damaged by it has disadvantage on the resulting concentration save.
/magic-item:masquerader-s-brooch: A Bonus Action creates a clothing and equipment illusion for 1 hour, exposed by physical inspection or DC 13 Investigation using Study. A Magic action casts Alter Self’s change appearance option without concentration.
/magic-item:noggenfogger-elixir: Roll 1d6: 1–2 grants skeletal appearance and no breathing for 1d4 hours; 3–4 applies Reduce for 1d4 hours without concentration; 5–6 slows falling to 60 feet per round and prevents falling damage for 10 minutes. Multiple doses avoid potion miscibility rolls.
/magic-item:salubrious-armor: While worn, grants +1 AC, increasing to +2 through the end of your next turn whenever you regain HP.
/magic-item:scroll-of-protection: A Magic action creates a 5-foot emanation for 5 minutes, preventing the specified creature type from entering or affecting anything inside. Moving the area onto such a creature ends it. A creature within 5 feet can use a Magic action and DC 15 Charisma save to overcome the effect for itself.
/magic-item:spell-duelist-s-trophy: Once per dawn, a melee spell hit can also cast Dispel Magic on the target. Spells cast using slots need no somatic components; the trophy also casts Mage Hand.
/magic-item:thayan-sword: A +1 sword with four charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. One charge casts Searing Smite, Thunderous Smite, or Wrathful Smite at DC 15. Once per dawn, dropping to 0 HP without dying outright instead leaves you at 1 HP.
/magic-item:wand-of-teeth: Ten charges, regain 1d10 at dawn. A Magic action spends up to three charges in a 30-foot cone: DC 15 Dexterity, 1d8 piercing per charge and Poisoned until your next turn on failure; half damage only on success. Last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:cauldron-of-rebirth: Functions as a spellcasting focus and Scrying component. After a Long Rest, creates a greater healing potion in 1 minute; it expires after 24 hours. Enlarge with a Magic action; a humanoid corpse covered in 200 pounds of salt for 8 hours returns as Raise Dead at dawn. Revival recharges after 7 days.
/magic-item:executioner-s-axe: A +1 weapon. Hits on Humanoids deal an extra 2d6 slashing damage and grant temporary HP equal to that extra damage.
/magic-item:hat-of-many-spells: A Wizard focus. Spend a slot to attempt an unknown Wizard spell of a castable level with materials costing at most 1,000 GP; DC 10 + spell level Arcana. Success casts normally and recharges after a Short or Long Rest. Failure produces a random spell or other unpredictable effect.
/magic-item:nolzur-s-marvelous-pigments: Contains 1d4 pots. One pot and 10 minutes of concentration create painted objects and terrain within a 20-foot cube; leaving or losing concentration wastes it. Individual objects are worth at most 25 GP, total 500 GP per pot; energy dissipates harmlessly.
/magic-item:potion-of-longevity: Reduces physical age by 1d6 + 6 years, minimum age 13. Each later dose adds a cumulative 10% chance of aging by that amount instead.
/magic-item:robe-of-thayan-arcana: While worn, increases spell save DC and spell attack bonus by 1, treats spell damage dice showing 1 as 2, and serves as a spellcasting focus.
/magic-item:spell-fuelling-armor: While worn, spell damage dice showing 1 count as 2. Once per dawn, after a Short Rest recover expended spell slots totaling at most three levels.
/magic-item:thunderous-greatclub: Sets Strength to 20 if lower. Hits add 1d8 thunder to creatures or 3d8 to unattended objects. A Magic action creates a 30-foot cone, DC 15 Strength or prone, and damages unattended objects for 3d8. Once per dawn an earthquake affects a 50-foot radius, damages structures for 50, can knock creatures prone or break concentration at DC 20, and opens a 30-foot-deep fissure.
/magic-item:workshop-wrecker: A Magic action activates the ball for 1 minute, once per dawn; a command within 30 feet stops it. On activation and each of your turns, creatures save Dexterity or take bludgeoning damage: 15-foot cube DC 18/6d6 + 5; 30-foot DC 17/4d6 + 4; 50-foot DC 15/2d6 + 2; 100-foot DC 14/1d6 + 1. Unattended nonmagical objects also take damage.
/magic-item:bloodvenom-blade: A +3 weapon that adds 2d6 poison damage and poisons a creature hit until the start of your next turn.
/magic-item:deck-of-many-things: Declare a number of cards before drawing from a 13- or 22-card deck; each takes effect immediately, and undrawn declared cards emerge after a gap over 1 hour. Effects range from Wish (1d3 castings), wealth, ability changes and magic items to imprisonment, loss of wealth or soul, curses and deadly enemies. Most drawn cards return; Fool and Jester do not.
/magic-item:grave-reaper: A +2 weapon adding 2d8 necrotic on a hit. Once per dawn casts Spirit Lantern at DC 17, with capacity for five soul fragments.
/magic-item:life-staff-of-the-web-lair: Eight charges, regain 1d6 + 2 at dawn; last charge risks destruction on a d20 roll of 1. Grants a climb speed equal to speed, hands-free wall and ceiling movement, web mobility and web contact awareness. One charge casts Web (DC 18); a Bonus Action and one charge deal 4d10 necrotic on a DC 18 Constitution failure to a creature in your Web, half on success, healing you for half the damage dealt.
/magic-item:rod-of-resurrection: Five charges; regain one at dawn. Heal costs one charge and Resurrection five. Spending the last charge risks the rod disappearing on a d20 roll of 1.
/magic-item:staff-of-the-spirit-aegis: A +3 Quarterstaff granting necrotic resistance while held. Once per dawn a Magic action creates a 30-foot aura for 1 hour: chosen creatures resist cold, necrotic and psychic damage, gain advantage against frightened, and undead attack them with disadvantage. A Bonus Action lights 15 feet bright plus 15 dim, revealing invisible creatures and objects in that light.
/magic-item:thrice-fanged-signet: When casting a spell, reduce current and maximum HP by 3d6 to resolve it as one slot level higher, up to level 9.
/magic-item:tome-of-the-stilled-tongue: Functions as a spellbook and Arcane Focus. Once per dawn, cast a spell written in it as a Bonus Action without a slot or verbal or somatic components. Removing its tongue permanently erases its spells; Vecna can observe its user and write messages.
/magic-item:axe-of-the-dwarvish-lords: A +3 axe; a natural 20 adds 20 slashing damage. Thrown 20/60 feet, it returns and adds 1d8 force, or 2d8 against Giants. Attunement grants 60-foot darkvision (or extends it 60 feet), +2 Constitution to 20, three artisan proficiencies, poison immunity and fire resistance. Once per dawn summon an Earth Elemental for up to 24 hours; teleport between stonework once per three days. Random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:book-of-vile-darkness: Non-Fiends and non-Undead must pass DC 17 Charisma on attunement or become a Larva; 80 hours of study unlocks its major abilities. Adjust one ability +2 (max 24) and another −2 (min 3), gain exhaustion immunity and advantage on evil lore. Once each per dawn cast Animate Dead, Circle of Death, Dominate Monster and Finger of Death (DC 18). Vile Speech deals 1d12 psychic to you and 3d6 to nearby non-Fiends/non-Undead. Evil conduct is required to retain it; random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:demonomicon-of-iggwilv: Grants advantage on demon lore and Abyss survival checks. Once per dawn traps a Fiend in Magic Circle on a DC 20 Charisma failure with disadvantage; trapped fiends can attempt possession after a Long Rest (DC 20). Fiend-targeted Magic Circle and Planar Binding cast at level 9 with disadvantaged saves, and spell damage against Fiends is maximized. Eight charges, regain 1d8 at dawn; spells use DC 20 and cost 0–3 charges. Random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:eye-and-hand-of-vecna: The grafted eye and hand each require removing the matching body part; removal kills the bearer, and either makes alignment Neutral Evil. Eye grants 240-foot truesight, 30-foot X-ray vision, and eight spell charges (DC 18, regain 1d4 + 4); each casting risks Vecna possession at 5%. Hand sets Strength to 20 if lower, adds 2d8 cold to qualifying melee attacks, and has its own eight charges; each casting subjects you to Suggestion. Together grant initiative advantage, poison immunity, 1d10 regeneration, a 7d6 necrotic action and Wish every 30 days.
/magic-item:light-s-vengeance: A +3 weapon adding 2d10 radiant against Undead. A Magic action forces Undead within 30 feet to make DC 20 Wisdom saves; failures take 4d8 radiant and are frightened and incapacitated for 1 minute, fleeing and ending the effect on damage. Random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:queen-ehlissa-s-marvelous-ni: A Magic action animates the bird to sing for 10 minutes, followed by a 1-hour cooldown. While singing, a 15-foot Zone of Truth uses DC 18 and Counterspell is available once per dawn. Six charges, regain 1d6 + 1 at dawn; a Bonus Action within 60 feet casts its listed spells at DC 18 for 0–6 charges. Random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:shalamayne: A +3 greatsword adding 2d12 force on a hit. With Greatsword mastery, both Graze and Sap apply. A Magic action ends attunement and splits it into two +3 finesse, light longswords; holding both permits rejoining and instant attunement. Has random beneficial artifact properties.
/magic-item:sword-of-kas: A +3 sword, critical on 19–20, adding 2d10 slashing against Undead. Add 1d10 initiative, resist necrotic, and transfer attack bonus to AC when attacking. Cast Call Lightning, Divine Word and Finger of Death once each per dawn (DC 18). If it tastes no blood within 1 minute of drawing, DC 15 Charisma: success deals 3d6 psychic; failure lets the sword dominate you until it gets blood. Sentient; random artifact properties apply.
/magic-item:wand-of-orcus: Attunement by anyone but Orcus requires DC 17 Constitution: success deals 10d6 necrotic; failure kills and turns a Humanoid into a Zombie. A +3 mace adding 2d12 necrotic, it grants +3 AC while held. Seven charges, regain 1d4 + 3 at dawn; casts listed spells at DC 18 for 1–4 charges. Once per dawn summons 15 Skeletons and 15 Zombies until dawn. Sentient, with random artifact properties.
